posts: We shipped the new dashboard this week. 3 months late. Here's what we got wrong.
We scoped the feature, not the transition. The migration work was invisible in our original estimate.
The #1 support request (real-time usage view) barely gets asked about anymore.
Lesson: estimate the migration, not just the feature.

linkedin_post:
We shipped our new dashboard this week, three months later than planned.

The reason: we scoped the feature itself, not the migration required to ship it. That cost was invisible in our original estimate.

Since launch, activation is up 18%, and the most-requested feature (a real-time usage view) has quietly stopped being requested.
newsletter_blurb: Why our dashboard launch ran three months late, and the 18% activation lift it delivered anyway. Read the full breakdown.
